title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
description: The former UK PM said "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning".

title: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation
description: No casualties were reported after a Russian drone struck a train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials left the area.

title: 'Culture shift' needed in how UK does business, PM urges
description: Burnham has said those who take risks should be backed by government, but his government has been criticised for increasing business costs.

title: Trump downplays warnings of AI risks as he cites rivalry with China
description: The US president said "negative forces" were airing concerns about "things that won't happen".

title: Deep-fried food banned under new school dinner rules in England
description: The government describes its new school food standards as "once-in-a-generation changes".

title: Will record donations to Reform go down as a moment of political change?
description: Andy Burnham is likely to face fresh pressure to further change the rules on party donations, writes Jack Fenwick.

title: Zverev caps transformational year with US Open triumph
description: Alexander Zverev lands his second Grand Slam title after ending Ben Shelton's hopes of becoming a rare home US Open men's champion.

title: Gloomy forecast for tenants as rent rises set to speed up
description: The cost of renting is expected to rise by 4% or 5% a year by December, according to property website Zoopla.

title: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
description: A partial count by Sweden's election authority projected that left-wing opposition bloc would win a three-seat majority.
